description: Score a résumé against open jobs, for an agent holding a CV: reads the occupation out of resumeText (or uses `query` if given), searches the board for it, and scores up to 20 results 0-100 with the matched and missing terms per job. PAID — needs a paid API key, exactly like POST /v1/fit on the data API, or a live Agent Pass on the key's account; a free key gets an in-band refusal naming where to upgrade. A null fit means the posting has no stored description to score. Returns the terms it read from the CV so the agent can pick a different one and call again with `query`. Needs a key or a sign-in.

query.description: Optional job title to search instead of the one read from the résumé.

resumeText.description: The candidate's résumé as plain text (100+ characters).

name: fit_resume

agenciesExcluded.description: Row-selecting: disclosed agency inventory is hidden from this page.

countUnavailable.description: The board could not count this query exactly — do not report a total.

ignoredFilters.description: Filters the board could NOT apply. Results answer a wider question than was asked.

intentFilters.description: Words read out of the query as filters.

agency.description: Present and true when the posting comes from a staffing/recruiting agency.

agentReady.description: True when request_application can submit to this hiring system.

companyToken.description: The employer handle; pass it back in search_jobs `companies`.

department.description: The employer's own team name. ABSENT when the posting carries none.

experienceBand.description: ABSENT when the posting's seniority could not be read.

fit.description: Keyword fit 0-100. NULL means the posting has no stored description to score — not a poor match.

id.description: vendor:employer:externalId — the id every other tool takes.

minYears.description: Years of experience the posting asks for. ABSENT when it names none (~71%).

postedAt.description: The employer's own date, ISO-8601. Null when the feed carries none — never the date we first saw it.

recheckedAt.description: When the employer's feed was last fetched and still carried this employer's board.

salary.description: The employer's own pay text, verbatim and unparsed.

salaryCurrency.description: ISO-4217, as stated. ABSENT when unstated.

salaryMaxAnnual.description: Annual USD-equivalent ceiling. ABSENT when unstated.

salaryMinAnnual.description: Annual USD-equivalent floor, parsed by the board. ABSENT when the posting states no pay — absence is not zero.

salaryPeriod.description: The period the employer stated: hour, month, year. ABSENT when unstated (~89% of the board).

workMode.description: Stated or inferred from title/location; null when neither says.

nextOffset.description: Pass back as `offset` for the next page.

query.description: What was actually searched. Null when no occupation was recognised.

salaryStatedOnly.description: Row-selecting: this page excludes the ~87% of postings with no stated pay.

terms.description: The occupations read out of the résumé, best first.

total.description: Exact match count. ABSENT with countUnavailable:true when the board refuses to guess.

title: Score a résumé against the board
